{{External|rs|rsc=Steel Plate Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Steel platebody |image = [[File:Steel platebody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 2000 |weight = 9.979 |respawn = 2000 |exchange = Yes |id = 1119 }} [[File:Steel platebody detail.png|120px|left]] The '''steel platebody''' is an armour used in [[melee]] with stat bonuses between [[Iron platebody|iron]] and [[Mithril platebody|mithril]] (not including the [[Black platebody|black]] and [[White platebody|white]] platebodies). It requires 5 [[Defence]] to equip and provides greater protection than a [[steel chainbody]]. Like all [[Platebody|platebodies]], however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] stats. Players with level 48 [[Smithing]] can make one by using 5 [[steel bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 187.5 [[experience]]. Alternatively, they can be bought from [[Horvik's Smithy]], [[Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop]], or in [[Varlamore]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -30 |arange = -15 |dstab = 32 |dslash = 31 |dcrush = 24 |dmagic = -6 |drange = 31 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Steel platebody equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Steel platebody equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 48 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 187.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Steel bar |mat1quantity = 5 |output1 = Steel platebody }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Steel platebody}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Steel platebody}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Steel platebody|location=[[Wilderness]] - [[Lava Maze]]|members=No|3085,3859|leagueRegion = Wilderness}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Steel platebody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platebody's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -10 to -15. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 March 2005 |update = Mountain Daughter and Changes |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Steel platebody detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Steel platebody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Steel platebody (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Steel platebody.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
